head: 62e4c1667e9cbbd89b557e58c68b767c6532f3e9
scope: Independent read-only source/P0-P2 review of the current-submission evidence repair; reviewer diagnosed the runtime bug but did not author this code. No author/root mutation, Dune/CI watch, full native transaction, sandbox/SDK/vendor/model execution or GitHub approval.
resolved_problem: The current submission no longer prepares evidence by remerging the previous Task handoff. A single transitioned_task supplies the current handoff/status to claim construction, request preparation, committed backlog and verification notification. Rejection/unroutable-release producers keep correlation in existing typed records instead of adding a bare verification ID as evidence.

production_trace.finding: Builds current immutable Task inside the existing locked transaction before deriving current claim or preparing the request; preparation precedes commit as before.
The returned Task is physically the same value inserted for the selected authoritative member; untouched Tasks remain unchanged.
Backlog commit and postcommit verification_notify use the same transitioned value; old status remains only for superseded identity, transition/audit and prior-owner semantics.

Preparation and public notification share the current-claim-only projection; required artifacts/criteria remain separate. Sandbox acquisition, producer execution identity capture and typed receipt are unchanged.
Rejected correction text/authority and typed pending outbox/event/activity verification identity are retained; only the incorrectly classified handoff evidence reference is removed.
Unroutable release retains correction reason and explicit verification_id activity field while retiring the exact old obligation; no bare correlation is converted into an artifact.

Operator cancellation still preserves the producer-owned handoff in both returned Task and backlog. persisted_handoff_context retains authored-by-this-transition meaning rather than relabeling inherited owner content.

all_api_consumers_checked.concrete_verification_evidence: Only production direct caller is Verification_protocol; all remaining former optional argument/helper names searched. The MLI now requires an explicit current claim.
all_api_consumers_checked.verification_submission_evidence_refs: Transition and all phase_e native callers updated; takes one already-transitioned Task rather than a parallel optional handoff.
all_api_consumers_checked.build_backlog_update: Transition and native handoff-boundary caller updated; all transition_backlog_update constructions/field uses searched.
all_api_consumers_checked.correlation_consumers: Completion_authority_wakeup and task rejection outbox consume typed task/verification identities; no production consumer was found interpreting bare handoff evidence as a verification ID.

unchanged_semantics_examined: No new note-only gate, permission, cap, numeric comparison, or spelling-based reference suppression. Explicit invalid current evidence still surfaces typed diagnostics.
Absent exit handoff clears previous data; entry preserves it without claiming new authorship. Required artifact contract strings remain separate from submitted evidence.
Noop checks, request compensation on failed commit, cancellation policy, supersede-delete order, stale verdict refusal and actor/model identity paths remain as before.

author_probe_reexecuted.scope: Actual pure modules/interfaces, grammar/codecs and receipt with named DTO/acquisition/load ports and an explicit ordering adapter; not the full Workspace transaction.

additional_controls.scope: Sibling Task identity, exact returned backlog member, authored metadata, entry handoff provenance, empty current claim, contract separation, correlation-looking narrative, note-only receipt.

native_fixture_assessment: The authored native Workspace submit->reject->changed-file->first-retry fixture meaningfully checks shared capture/notification Task, actual snapshot bytes, first request immutability, producer/model/tool source identity, no capture diagnostics and stale verdict rejection. Existing release/outbox and independent Task behavior are covered. None of those native fixtures was executed in this review. Existing Operator_cancel handoff preservation coverage is in test_workspace outside the four recommended minimal suites.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Comment still says verification ID travels on the handoff context, but this repair correctly keeps it in typed verdict/outbox/activity correlation. Documentation cleanup only.

verification_submitted_fn scheduling hook still receives the pre-existing status-only old Task reconstruction. Current production install_callback reads only task.id and uses a fresh backlog review, so it does not recontaminate evidence and is not a current P0-P2. Avoid claiming every hook receives the same snapshot; a later cleanup can pass transitioned_task there too.
